data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 万世桥畔的秋日私语
data.description: 秋叶原车站旁的长风吹乱了她的发梢。红莉栖双手插在高领毛衣的口袋里，停在桥栏前看着电车驶过。当掌心被悄悄握住的瞬间，她睫毛轻颤，没有把手抽开。
data.location: historic brick arch bridge over Kanda River with passing commuter trains
data.action: standing at the iron bridge railing at sunset, fingers intertwined with partner, autumn wind fluttering auburn hair as trains pass beneath
data.lighting: dazzling orange-gold dusk sunlight reflecting on river waves and red brickwork
data.mood: melancholic nostalgic beauty, tender romantic connection, autumn city serenity
data.promptProse: Standing on an autumn bridge during golden hour, Kurisu looks down at intertwined hands with soft flushed cheeks as commuter trains cross in the distance.
data.animaCaption: Kurisu standing on a Tokyo bridge at sunset holding hands with windblown hair.
